_metadata.description: Text and lyrics to song, instrumental, and sound-effect generation with reproducible parameters.

requirements.title: Composition from caption and optional lyrics
requirements.description: Generation accepts a structured caption plus optional section-tagged lyrics and duration, and returns audio with every parameter needed to reproduce it recorded against the output.

validation.notes: Generation persistence is covered by the shipped composition tests
CLI domain dispatch is covered by the shipped CLI tests

requirements.title: Instrumental and effect generation
requirements.description: Instrumental-only output and short sound-effect generation are addressable operations, not prompt conventions, so consuming scenarios can request them explicitly.

validation.notes: Instrumental/effect composition behavior is covered by the shipped composition tests
